units.summary: Adds a test that evicts a series via CompactSelectedSeries, forces a WAL checkpoint, and asserts the evicted series record is retained. It only covers the new path and does not affect production code.
units.headline: New test: evicted selected series stays in WAL checkpoint
units.reason: New test-only code; cannot affect production behavior and adds coverage.

units.summary: Generalizes the stale-only truncation into a predicate-driven truncateSeries that returns the evicted count. The head MinTime guard is relaxed from >= to >, so a single-timestamp head (MinTime == maxt) is now evicted. Tombstones are still logged to the WAL for deleted refs.
units.headline: truncateSeries takes eviction predicate; MinTime==maxt heads now evicted
units.reason: Changes eviction boundary condition and error return in head series deletion and WAL tombstone logic, which affects persisted data.
focus: MinTime > maxt guard now lets MinTime == maxt proceed: confirm WaitForPendingReadersInTimeRange and gc are correct for a single-timestamp range
all callers handle the new (int, error) return and the shouldEvict predicate
tombstones recorded only for refs actually deleted

units.summary: Renames gcStaleSeries to gcSeries and takes a shouldEvict predicate. numStaleSeries is now decremented only by the count of deleted series that were actually stale, instead of by all deleted series, which keeps the counter correct when non-stale series are evicted.
units.headline: gcSeries decrements stale-series counter only for stale evictions
units.reason: Changes head metric and counter accounting and the eviction predicate, which affects runtime state.
focus: numStaleSeries stays consistent with isStaleSeries at deletion time, with no underflow
numSeries, chunk and postings updates are unchanged for non-stale deletions

units.summary: The stale check inside the per-series deletion callback is replaced by a caller-supplied shouldEvict predicate. The function also counts deleted series that are stale and returns that count. Skip checks for refs not provided and for series with newer samples are kept.
units.headline: stripeSeries gcSeries uses pluggable eviction predicate, counts stale deletions
units.reason: Core series deletion condition is changed from a hard-coded stale check to a predicate, so non-stale series can now be deleted.
risk_signals: concurrency: runs under series locks via iterForDeletion
focus: shouldEvict is called with the series lock held, and isStaleSeries is evaluated before deletion
staleSeriesDeleted is counted exactly once per deleted series
stale eviction path still requires stale, no-OOO and appendID checks
